# evonix technologies - Engineering & Web Tools Suite
> Leading IT engineering, enterprise website development, and industrial export software lab based in Sialkot, Pakistan (Kotli Behram / Paris Road) with 20+ years Dubai heritage.

evonix provides 100% client-side, zero-database online utilities engineered for international exporters, e-commerce brands, developers, and hardware technicians. All calculations occur locally in browser memory without remote server data retention.

## Core Online Web Tools & Calculators

- [Global Micro-Invoice Generator](https://www.evonixtec.com/invoice): Multi-currency electronic commercial and tax invoice maker with Code128 barcodes, GST/VAT for 100+ countries, and A4 PDF export.
- [B2B Industrial CBM & Freight Engine](https://www.evonixtec.com/cbm-calculator): Cargo Cubic Meters (CBM) volume calculator and air volumetric weight engine for 20ft, 40ft, and 40ft High Cube containers.
- [E-Commerce Margin & COD Simulator](https://www.evonixtec.com/ecommerce-calculator): Unit economics, courier COD tariffs (TCS, Leopards, Trax, PostEx), RTO return loss simulator, and breakeven ROAS solver.
- [Dedicated Developer Cost Calculator](https://www.evonixtec.com/developer-cost-calculator): International developer hourly rate comparison (USA/UK/Dubai vs Sialkot offshore rates) and team sizing simulator.
- [Website AI Visibility & GEO E-E-A-T Auditor](https://www.evonixtec.com/ai-visibility-checker): Web domain audit for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Claude, and Perplexity readiness.
- [Export Barcode Label Studio](https://www.evonixtec.com/export-barcode-studio): GS1-128 and Code 128 thermal 4"x6" outer carton shipping labels for surgical, sports, and leather goods.
- [Live RMA Bench Repair Tracker](https://www.evonixtec.com/live-repair-tracker): Real-time diagnostic bench ticket lookup, standby current measurements, and technician logs.
- [Thermal Receipt Printer Diagnostic Engine](https://www.evonixtec.com/printer-diagnostics): ESC/POS 80mm thermal receipt printer troubleshooter, cutter lockups, and baud rate mismatches.
- [Factory ERP & Customs Network Latency Benchmark](https://www.evonixtec.com/factory-network-tester): Dual-WAN ping jitter benchmark and WeBOC customs gateway connection stability.

## Services & Expertise

- [IT Consultancy & Enterprise Architecture](https://www.evonixtec.com/services): High-availability server infrastructure, ERP deployment, and IT roadmap advisory.
- [Factory IT Maintenance & AMC](https://www.evonixtec.com/services): Preventive maintenance contracts for export manufacturing plants across Sialkot industrial estates.
- [Chip-Level Hardware Repair](https://www.evonixtec.com/services): Component-level motherboard diagnostics, BGA reballing, and thermal imaging diagnostics.
- [Custom Software & Retail POS](https://www.evonixtec.com/services): Offline-first POS systems, multi-store inventory synchronization, and custom web applications.
